# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We will support the current major release as well as the previous major release branch for all critical security fixes, while still following [semantic version standards](https://semver.org/).

This means if the latest version is `3.x.x`, we will add a hot fix to the `2.x.x` branch, but not anything older.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If there is a published security issue with one of our dependencies that has a fix released, please create an issue or pull request with the required change.

Please report any other security issues by opening a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/ExpediaGroup/mockql-rs/security/advisories/new).
